opened_app_no_action: You logged in for accountability and left before it happened.
You visited productivity like a tourist.
Your presence was noted. Your effort was not.
You inspected your responsibilities and quietly backed away.
You wanted the feeling of productivity, not the work.
You monitored your goals like a spectator sport.
incomplete_tasks: The task is still waiting. It has more patience than you have discipline.
You postponed effort but expected progress.
Half-starting things is your most consistent habit.
You keep beginning tasks the way trailers begin movies — no release date.
You prepared perfectly to not execute.
The checklist exists. Completion does not.
You made a plan and then negotiated against it.
You approached the work and chose comfort instead.
You invested energy into avoiding a smaller amount of energy.
tomorrow_not_done: Tomorrow has carried your responsibilities for a long time.
You delegated your life to a date that never arrives.
You trust future-you with tasks present-you refuses to touch.
Tomorrow is now yesterday. The result is the same.
Your schedule is optimistic. Your actions are not.
You keep moving the deadline like it offended you.
You reschedule effort more reliably than you perform it.
You planned a better day instead of creating one.
You keep promising improvement to a calendar.
You believe time passing equals progress.
streak_missed: You paused long enough to become comfortable stopping.
One day off became a decision.
You broke routine faster than you built it.
You remembered the goal after skipping it.
The system worked. Participation did not.
You lost momentum and made no attempt to recover it.
Your habit depended entirely on mood.
You expected discipline to maintain itself.
You treated a routine like an option.
streak_missed_consecutive: This is no longer a mistake. It is a pattern.
You didn’t fall off track. You walked away from it.
The habit stopped. You did not restart it.
You abandoned consistency before it could help you.
You now rely on intention instead of action.
You keep restarting mentally, never behaviorally.
You remember the goal only when it’s too late for the day.
At this point you are maintaining avoidance, not a routine.
You are planning a comeback you never schedule.
The effort gap is now measurable.
no_login: Avoiding the tracker does not reset the behavior.
You stopped checking because the data was honest.
Silence from you does not equal progress.
You ignored the reminder and hoped the outcome would differ.
You removed observation instead of fixing action.
You knew what you would see and chose not to see it.
You avoided measurement to protect comfort.
Your goals existed today. You did not engage with them.
frequent_task_removal: You manage the list more than the work.
You edited commitments instead of honoring them.
You are organizing avoidance very efficiently.
You remove tasks the moment they become real.
You maintain a cleaner list, not a better day.
You solved the reminder, not the responsibility.
You keep optimizing the system to avoid execution.
You reduce obligations without reducing consequences.
You curate tasks instead of completing them.
You control the tracker because you won’t control the behavior.
